comment: Copy to leader_map.json next to leader_decoder.py (gitignored) and fill in.
Per joint: sdk_deg = sign * continuous_deg + offset_deg, then converted to radians.
offset_deg  leader angle that must map to the vendor zero for this joint.
unwrap      true if the joint travels more than one full turn.
calibrated  must be true before app.py will accept --backend sdk.
reference_deg  the raw leader angles at the pose the offsets were measured
at. Provenance, not a gate: it records where the numbers came
from, and re-running leader_calibrate.py should reproduce it.
A session does not have to start there. The encoder reports one
number per turn, so which turn a joint is on is settled when the
operator arms, from the arm's own measured pose; the leader then
only has to be in that same pose to within 30 deg.
Values below are placeholders, not a calibration.
